title: Roberts Street Chapel
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: The word ‘chapel’ may have different meanings for different people, but this Chapel is open to people of all religious and secular beliefs, free of charge, and full of art. Anybody can come and stay. Prayer, meditation, thought - whatever it is that you want to do in this space, it is a space created for the purpose of providing inspiration and comfort.
